流程协调：把前后台串起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的文职处理区——查询、录入、归档都能被系统和机器人流程替代，但核异常和复杂答复还留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化动作」，不是「岗位」。会管系统、能核异常、做复杂咨询的人，反而随自助分流变得更稀缺。怕的是只会录入归档的文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 行政文职打底，在校多练办公软件和系统操作。AI 时代拼的是数据管理，别只当录入员。
从「录信息」升级成「管系统 + 核异常」，学 RPA 和档案数字化。转数据运营支持更稳。
突出你管过什么系统、处理过什么异常。有系统和数据经验优先。
招人看细心和系统能力，不止看打字速度。能管数据核异常的文员值得留用。

ai_s7_trends: 智能客服与 RPA 继续分流基础查询录入。
档案全面电子化，OCR 普及。
会管系统核数据的文员更稀缺。

body: 信息与记录文员在政府和企业中负责信息查询与答复、记录登记、档案归档、表格处理与来访接待，是连接组织内外信息需求的基础服务岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把档案检索做成一句话问答，但「这条记录为什么对不上」，还得人去源头核。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can run standard diagnostics, but analysts still decide which clients merit attention and how to turn findings into practical improvements.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 1,075,100 management analysts employed in 2024, projected to reach 1,169,700 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 94,600 jobs, with roughly 98,100 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $101,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace management analysis, but it will reduce standardized roles. Templated solutions and self-service analytics accelerate routine diagnosis, shifting analysts from report production toward client development, tailored solutions, implementation, and long-term support. Standard-template-only roles face pressure, while people who understand operations and deliver results become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Customer relationships: people cultivate trust.
Solution customization: people uncover the pain points.
Implementation: people overcome resistance.
Presentation and communication: people persuade buyers.
Long-term support: people build relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: An 8/10 score places this occupation at high AI exposure in consulting. Systems accelerate standard diagnosis, while client development and implementation remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: High exposure does not mean high risk. AI replaces standard-template production, not client development and implementation. Analysts with operating ability who deliver results become scarcer as productivity rises; consultants limited to standard reports face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If starting from business or engineering, practice data analysis and interviewing. Pure template work is shrinking in the AI era, so build commercial skills early.
Advance from report production toward solutions plus implementation. Learn business and data.
Emphasize projects and implemented results and state which industries you served.
Do not hire solely for academic credentials. Look for implementation judgment; core analysts who drive improvements merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Templating absorbs standard roles.
Implementation creates opportunities.
Consultants with commercial ability become more sought after.

body: Management analysts lead organizational and process diagnosis and improvement, integrating interviews, data, and solutions and using analysis and communication to drive implementation, improve efficiency, and reduce costs.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can run standard diagnostics, but analysts still decide which clients merit attention and how to turn findings into practical improvements.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能跑标准诊断，但哪类客户值得跟、怎么讲成可落地的改进，还是分析师定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年管理咨询分析师在岗约 107.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 116.97 万人，净增约 9.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 9.81 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.12 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代管理分析，但会压缩标准岗。模板化方案与自助分析把常规诊断提速，分析师从「出报告」挪向「客户经营、方案定制、落地推动、长期陪跑」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准模板的，有经营力能落地的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 客户经营：信任靠人养。
方案定制：痛点靠人挖。
落地推动：阻力靠人破。
汇报沟通：买单选人讲。
长期陪跑：关系靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 8/10 说明这个职业处在高 AI 曝光的咨询区——标准诊断被系统加速，但经营与落地还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「做标准模板」动作，不是「客户经营与落地」的岗位。有经营力、能推动落地的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只出标准报告的顾问。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 商科 / 工科起步多练数据和访谈，AI 时代纯模板在缩，早点练经营。
从「出报告」升级成「做方案 + 推落地」，学业务和数据。
突出项目和落地结果，写清跟过哪些行业。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有落地脑子。能推改进的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 模板化吃标准岗。
落地推动带来机会。
有经营力的顾问更抢手。

body: Management analysts（管理咨询分析师）主导组织与流程的诊断改进，统筹访谈、数据与方案，运用分析与沟通推动落地，帮助企业提效率、降成本。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能跑标准诊断，但哪类客户值得跟、怎么讲成可落地的改进，还是分析师定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Remote diagnostics can report faults first, but repairers still decide which machine to disassemble, how to calibrate it, and how to coordinate with clinical teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 68,000 medical equipment repairers employed in 2024, projected to rise to 76,800 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 8,800 jobs, with roughly 7,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $62,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace medical equipment repairers, but it will reduce routine labor hours. Remote diagnostics and spare-parts systems accelerate standard repairs, shifting work from repeated trials toward precise disassembly and replacement, clinical coordination, and emergency repair. People who only replace standard components face displacement, while those who understand precision and nonstandard equipment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-site troubleshooting: people judge nonstandard faults.
Parameter calibration: people assure precision.
Clinical coordination: people communicate.
Emergency repair decisions require human tradeoffs.
Experience transfer: people teach hands-on judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a medium-to-high-exposure category. Diagnosis and documentation become faster, but people still perform on-site disassembly and work with clinical teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces standard component swaps, not clinical emergency repair. People who understand precision and nonstandard equipment become scarcer as the installed equipment base grows, while workers who only replace standard parts face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in electromechanical or biomedical engineering and practice reading drawings and testing. Pure component replacement is shrinking in the AI era, so develop diagnostic skills early.
Advance from component replacement to diagnosis + maintenance and learn remote diagnostics.
Highlight credentials and equipment experience and specify the clinical departments you have supported.
Do not select candidates solely for speed; assess whether they coordinate effectively with clinical teams. Core repairers deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Remote diagnostics spread.
The installed equipment base grows steadily.
People who diagnose faults are more sought after.

body: Medical equipment repairers service hospital diagnostic and therapeutic equipment, locate electronic and mechanical faults, replace components, calibrate parameters, restore clinical usability, and support emergency response.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Remote diagnostics can report faults first, but repairers still decide which machine to disassemble, how to calibrate it, and how to coordinate with clinical teams.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 远程诊断能先报故障，但哪台该拆、怎么校准、临床怎么配，还是维修员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医疗设备维修人员在岗约 6.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.68 万人，净增约 0.88 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.73 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医疗设备维修，但会压缩常规工时。远程诊断与备件系统把标准故障提速，维修从「反复试」挪向「精准拆换、临床配合、应急抢修」。真正被挤掉的是只换标准件的人，懂精密非标的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场排障：非标靠人判。
参数校准：精准靠人。
临床配合：沟通靠人。
应急抢修：取舍靠人。
经验传承：手感靠人带。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——诊断与文档被加速，但现场拆装与临床仍靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「换标准件」动作，不是「临床抢修」的岗位。懂精密非标的人，反而随设备存量更稀缺。怕的是只会换标准件。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电/医工起步多练读图与测试，AI 时代纯换件在缩，早点练诊断。
从「换件」升级成「诊断 + 保养」，学远程诊断。
突出证书与设备经验，写清跟过哪些科室。
选人别只看手快，要看会不会临床配合。骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 远程诊断普及。
设备存量稳增。
会诊断的人更抢手。

body: 医疗设备维修员检修医院诊断与治疗设备，定位电子与机械故障、更换部件、校准参数，恢复临床可用并配合应急响应。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 远程诊断能先报故障，但哪台该拆、怎么校准、临床怎么配，还是维修员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate a complete set of eye-alignment data in seconds, but an orthoptist still has to coax a child through the examination and persuade parents to continue the training.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that in 2024, about 41,300 orthoptists were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 42,200, a net increase of about 900 jobs, with about 2,400 openings per year. In 2026, the median annual salary is about $113,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace orthoptists, but it will accelerate examination and analysis. Automated eye-position tracking, image analysis, and data reports let orthoptists shift time from organizing data to conducting examinations, designing plans, and communicating with parents. The truly scarce skill is gaining cooperation from children and parents and sustaining adherence to the plan.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted image analysis of strabismus angle
Remote visual function assessment and follow-up
AI case libraries supporting diagnosis and plan recommendations
ai_s2_auto: Automated collection and analysis of eye alignment and binocular vision data
Template-based generation of examination reports and clinical records
ai_s3_list: Guiding cooperation during examinations: AI cannot learn how to comfort a crying child.
Clinical judgment: beyond the data, the child's cooperation and the parents' descriptions must be considered together.
Training plan design: every child is different, so each plan must be individualized.
Patient communication: translating technical terms into language parents understand and will act on.
Collaboration with ophthalmologists: understanding how examination results affect treatment decisions requires clinical context.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that a substantial part of this occupation involves data and desk work. Examination records, reports, and analysis are precisely where AI accelerates work effectively.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Conducting examinations, delivering training, and communicating with patients depend on people. AI replaces data analysis, not direct patient care. The occupation's true constraint is the small number of positions, not AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Optometry is the most directly relevant field of study. Seek internships at ophthalmology hospitals early and shadow strabismus and binocular vision examinations. Build strong vision therapy and child communication skills because talent in this specialty is already scarce.
Use digital examination and AI analysis tools, and devote the saved time to complex cases and training plans. Follow emerging models such as remote visual function assessment to expand service reach.

People with nursing, optometry, or clinical backgrounds can enter the field by pursuing shadowing and internships at ophthalmology hospitals. Obtain relevant professional credentials; experience in strabismus correction and vision therapy is the strongest entry qualification.

When hiring orthoptists, assess actual examination volume and training cases, not education alone. Equipping the role with digital examination devices and AI-assisted tools significantly improves efficiency and service capacity.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Eye-movement trajectories and strabismus angle measurement
Eye alignment, stereopsis, and fusion function
Supporting occlusion plans and lens prescriptions
ai_s6_tools.工具: Management of occlusion and Fresnel prism supplies

ai_s7_trends: Eye-alignment examinations and data analysis are becoming digital, with report generation almost fully automated.
Vision therapy is becoming digital, gamified, and remote, expanding service reach.
Policies addressing childhood myopia, strabismus, and amblyopia are increasing demand for visual rehabilitation roles.

body: Orthoptists work under ophthalmologists to examine and assess binocular vision disorders such as strabismus, amblyopia, and diplopia, deliver vision therapy and corrective plans, and continuously track and record outcomes throughout treatment.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate a complete set of eye-alignment data in seconds, but an orthoptist still has to coax a child through the examination and persuade parents to continue the training.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能几秒钟算完一套眼位数据，但「怎么哄孩子配合检查、怎么让家长愿意坚持训练」，还得视轴矫正师来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年视轴矫正师在岗约 4.13 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.22 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.24 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代视轴矫正师，但会加速检查与分析环节。自动眼位追踪、影像分析、数据报告都能交给 AI 提速，矫正师的时间从「整理数据」挪向「检查执行、方案设计和家长沟通」。真正稀缺的，是让患儿和家长愿意配合、把方案坚持做下去的能力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的斜视度影像分析
视功能训练的数字化与游戏化
远程视功能评估与随访
AI 病例库辅助诊断与方案推荐
ai_s2_auto: 眼位与双眼视数据的自动采集分析
检查报告与病历记录的模板化生成
训练进度的数据记录与跟踪
预约与随访提醒的自动化
ai_s3_list: 检查配合引导：面对哭闹的孩子，AI 学不会怎么哄。
临床判断：数据之外，孩子的配合度、家长的描述都要综合看。
训练方案设计：每个孩子情况不同，方案要因人而异。
医患沟通：把专业术语讲成家长听得懂、愿意坚持的话。
与眼科医师的协作：检查结果如何影响治疗决策，需要临床语境。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当一部分工作在数据与案头——检查记录、报告、分析，这些正是 AI 擅长加速的领域。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：检查执行、训练实施和医患沟通依赖人，AI 替代的是「分析数据」而不是「面对患者」。这个职业真正的瓶颈是岗位数量少，而不是 AI。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 眼视光学是明确对口方向，尽早进入眼科医院实习，跟岗学斜视与双眼视检查。把视功能训练和儿童沟通能力练好，这个细分领域人才本来就少。
把数字化检查和 AI 分析工具用起来，把时间投到复杂病例和训练方案上。关注远程视功能评估等新模式，拓展服务半径。
护理、视光或临床背景都可以切入，先争取眼科医院的跟岗和实习机会。考取相关执业资质，斜视矫正和视功能训练经验是最大的敲门砖。
招视轴矫正师别只看学历，要看实际检查量和训练案例。给岗位配数字化检查设备和 AI 辅助工具，能显著提升效率和服务量。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 遮盖方案、镜片处方配套
ai_s6_tools.工具: 遮盖/压贴棱镜耗材管理

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 相似病例检索、方案建议

ai_s7_trends: 眼位检查与数据分析数字化，报告生成几乎全自动。
视功能训练向数字化、游戏化和远程化发展，服务半径扩大。
儿童近视与斜弱视防控政策推动下，视功能康复岗位需求上升。

body: 视轴矫正师（Orthoptists）在眼科医师指导下，检查与评估斜视、弱视、复视等双眼视功能障碍，实施视功能训练与矫正方案，并在治疗过程中持续跟踪记录效果。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能几秒钟算完一套眼位数据，但「怎么哄孩子配合检查、怎么让家长愿意坚持训练」，还得视轴矫正师来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated production lines can replace material loading, but operators still control changeovers, machine adjustments, and quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 97,500 machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to fall to 91,400, a net decrease of about 6,100 jobs, with about 8,100 openings per year. In 2026, median annual pay was about $49,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace operators, but it will reduce repetitive roles. Robotic arms and automated production lines replace loading and sorting, shifting operators from tending machines to changeovers, machine adjustment, quality control, and equipment coordination. Purely repetitive work is being displaced, while people who can adjust machines become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Changeover and machine adjustment: people provide the feel.
Quality decisions require human experience.
Exception handling: people make tradeoffs.
Process fine-tuning: people adjust parameters.
Equipment coordination: people manage collaboration.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates moderately high exposure on production lines. Repetitive operations are accelerated, but people still adjust machines and inspect quality.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Repetitive loading is being replaced, not roles involving changeovers, machine adjustment, and quality inspection. People who operate multiple machine types and control quality become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learning a trade matters more than fearing dirt and hard work. Develop machine-adjustment and multi-machine skills early.
Advance from tending machines to machine adjustment + quality inspection, and learn to coordinate with automated production lines.
Highlight experience with specific machine types. Factories value steadiness and speed.
Do not evaluate candidates by strength alone. Assess their ability to adjust machines and control quality.

ai_s7_trends: Automated production lines are spreading, reducing repetitive roles.
People with multi-machine skills are valued more highly.
People who can adjust machines have greater job stability.

body: Paper goods machine operators run paper-processing equipment that turns raw paper into cartons, bags, and other products. They load materials, adjust machines, monitor operations, and control quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated production lines can replace material loading, but operators still control changeovers, machine adjustments, and quality.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动产线能替上料，但换型调机与质量，还是操作工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 9.75 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.14 万人，岗位净减约 0.61 万个，年均产生约 0.81 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.94 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代操作工，但会压缩重复岗。机械臂与自动产线替掉上料分拣，操作工从「守机器」挪向「换型调机、质量把控、设备协作」。被挤掉的是纯重复操作，会调机的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 换型调机：手感靠人。
质量判断：经验靠人。
异常处理：取舍靠人。
工艺微调：参数靠人。
设备协作：配合靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的产线区——重复操作被加速，但调机与质检还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「重复上料」，不是「换型调机与质检」的岗位。会多机种、能把关的人，反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学门手艺比怕脏累重要，早练调机和多机种。
从「守机」升级成「调机 + 质检」，学自动产线协作。
突出机种经验，厂里看重稳和快。
选人别只看力气，看他会不会调机和把关。

ai_s7_trends: 自动产线普及，重复岗缩。
多机种人才更被看重。
会调机的人更稳。

body: 纸制品机器操作工操作纸品加工设备，将原纸制成纸箱、纸袋等产品，负责上料、调机、监控与质量把控。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动产线能替上料，但换型调机与质量，还是操作工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Self-service terminals can handle routine mailing, but clerks still verify identities, resolve difficult cases, and reassure customers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 74,200 postal service clerks were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 71,600 by 2034, a net loss of about 2,600 jobs, with about 6,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $61,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postal clerks, but it will reduce routine business. Self-service terminals and online systems accelerate mailing and tracking, shifting clerks from standard transactions toward identity verification, complex items, service for older customers, and counter management. People limited to routine entry will be displaced, while those who understand rules and serve well are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Identity verification: people maintain compliance.
Difficult-case handling: people make judgments.
Customer reassurance: people handle emotions.
Cash redemption: people bear responsibility.
Counter management: people coordinate operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed field. Routine transactions accelerate, but verification and service still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is entering standard forms, not verification and service roles. People who serve well and understand rules become scarcer as self-service spreads. Those limited to routine entry face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is a stable entry path, but pure data entry is shrinking in the AI era, so develop service and verification skills early.
Advance from handling transactions to counter management + difficult customer service, and learn systems and rules.
Emphasize accuracy and patience, and specify the transaction types you have handled.
Hire for steadiness and service orientation. Core staff who can run a counter are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Self-service and online systems absorb routine business.
People remain essential for older-customer and verification services.
People with service skills are more secure.

body: Postal service clerks handle mailing, stamps, money orders, registered-mail tracking, and other public transactions at post-office counters, operate dedicated systems, and ensure accurate, compliant service.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Self-service terminals can handle routine mailing, but clerks still verify identities, resolve difficult cases, and reassure customers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自助终端能办常规寄件，但核验身份、处理疑难和安抚客户，还是文员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年邮政服务文员在岗约 7.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 7.16 万人，岗位净减约 0.26 万个，年均产生约 0.61 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.16 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代邮政文员，但会压缩常规业务。自助终端与线上系统把寄件和查询提速，文员从「办标准业务」挪向「核验身份、处理复杂件、服务老年客户、做柜台管理」。真正被挤掉的是只办常规录入的人，懂规则和会服务的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 身份核验：合规靠人。
疑难处理：判断靠人。
客户安抚：情绪靠人。
现金兑付：责任靠人。
柜台管理：统筹靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——常规业务被加速，但核验与服务还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「录标准单」动作，不是「核验与服务」的岗位。会服务和懂规则的人，反而随自助普及更稀缺。怕的是只会办常规录入的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 求稳可入，AI 时代纯录入在缩，早点练服务和核验。
从「办业务」升级成「管柜台 + 服务疑难」，学系统和规则。
突出准确和耐心，写清办过哪些业务类型。
选人看稳重和服务意识，能压柜台的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 自助与线上吃常规业务。
老年与核验服务仍要人。
懂服务的人更稳。

body: 邮政服务文员在邮局柜台办理邮件收寄、邮票与汇票、挂号查询等公众业务，操作专用系统并保证业务准确合规。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自助终端能办常规寄件，但核验身份、处理疑难和安抚客户，还是文员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag suspicious images, but technologists still use experience to determine whether positioning is correct and whether a patient held their breath long enough.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 228,000 technologists and technicians were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 237,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,800 jobs, with about 12,900 openings annually and median annual pay of about $77,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace radiologic technologists, but it will assist imaging. Parameter recommendations and image postprocessing increase efficiency, while AI preliminary screening absorbs some recognition work. Technologists shift from simply acquiring images toward precise positioning + patient management + quality control. Roles limited to fixed-protocol imaging face the greatest pressure, while people who understand equipment and communicate well become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Precise positioning: people determine the angle.
Patient communication: people ease anxiety.
Radiation protection: people safeguard safety.
Image quality control: people judge clarity.
On-site emergency response: people handle unexpected events.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that this occupation has medium AI exposure in an assistive role: systems accelerate image acquisition and preliminary screening, while positioning and communication still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: fixed-protocol image acquisition and preliminary screening are replaced, not precise positioning and patient-management roles. People who understand equipment and communicate well become scarcer as tools spread. Those limited to following protocols face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in medical imaging and earn credentials early. Pure image acquisition is shrinking in the AI era, so develop positioning and communication skills.
Advance from taking images to precise positioning + quality control, and learn MRI/CT and AI tools.
Highlight equipment and disease-specific experience, and specify the machine models you operate.
Do not hire based only on speed. Look for radiation-protection and communication skills. Technologists who perform quality control deserve performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Imaging demand rises with population aging.
AI preliminary screening replaces some identification work.
Technologists who understand equipment and communicate well are more secure.

body: Radiologic technologists and technicians operate imaging equipment under medical orders, position patients and provide radiation protection, acquire and preliminarily verify clear images, and deliver them to physicians for diagnosis.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can flag suspicious images, but technologists still use experience to determine whether positioning is correct and whether a patient held their breath long enough.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能标出可疑影，但那个体位摆得对不对、病人憋气够不够，还是技师凭经验定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术专家技术员在岗约 22.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.78 万人，净增约 0.98 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.77 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代放射科技师，但会辅助成像。参数推荐与图像后处理提速，AI 初筛吃部分识别，技师从「纯取图」挪向「精准摆位 + 病人管理 + 质控」。真正被挤掉的是只按固定流程拍的人，懂设备会沟通的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 精准摆位：角度靠人定。
病人沟通：紧张靠人抚。
辐射防护：安全靠人守。
图像质控：清浊靠人判。
现场应急：突发靠人处。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的辅助区——取图与初筛被系统提速，摆位沟通还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「固定流程取图与初筛」动作，不是「精准摆位与病人管理」的岗位。懂设备、会沟通的人反而随工具更稀缺。怕的是只按流程拍的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学影像专业打底，早考证。AI 时代纯取图在缩，早点练摆位和沟通。
从「拍片」升级成「精准摆位 + 质控」，学 MRI/CT 和 AI 工具。
突出设备与病种经验，写清会哪些机型。
选人别只看快，看防护和沟通。能质控的技师值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 影像需求随老龄化涨。
AI 初筛替部分识别。
懂设备会沟通的技师更稳。

body: 放射科技师与技术员按医嘱操作影像设备为患者成像，做好辐射防护与体位摆放，获取清晰图像并初步核对，交付医生诊断。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能标出可疑影，但那个体位摆得对不对、病人憋气够不够，还是技师凭经验定的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Automated monitoring can report RPM, but sailors and marine oilers still rush in when a line suddenly snaps or an unusual engine-room noise appears.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 32,100 sailors and marine oilers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 32,800 by 2034, a net increase of about 700 jobs, with about 3,900 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $49,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace sailors and marine oilers and is unlikely to reduce these jobs significantly. Ship automation handles navigation assistance and equipment monitoring, but deck work, engine-room maintenance, and emergencies depend heavily on people, especially during unexpected events at sea. Versatile, certified crew members who respond to emergencies are more secure, while systems reduce single-purpose monitoring work.
ai_s3_list: Deck work: people handle mooring and lookout duties.
Engine-room maintenance: people lubricate equipment and tighten bolts.
Emergency response: people handle storms and breakdowns.
Abnormality detection: experience identifies unusual sounds.
Integrated coordination: connecting deck and engine-room operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in a moderately high exposure range. Systems divert navigation and monitoring work, but people remain essential on deck, in engine rooms, and during emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure means stability here. Automation replaces single-purpose monitoring, not the occupation. Versatile, certified people who handle emergencies become scarcer as automation spreads. Sailors who only watch gauges and do not learn multiple roles face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in navigation or marine engineering and obtain seafarer credentials while in school. Monitoring is being automated in the AI era, so develop multiple-role and emergency-response skills early.
Advance from a single role to deck + engine-room versatility, learn automated monitoring, and pursue senior seafarer certification.
Highlight sea experience and certifications and list the vessel types you have served on. Applicants with seafarer credentials receive priority.
Do not hire based only on strength; evaluate compliance and emergency response. Versatile certified sailors merit higher voyage bonuses.

ai_s7_trends: Navigation and engine-room monitoring will continue to automate.
Versatile certified seafarers are increasingly valued.
Predictive maintenance improves safety.

body: Sailors and marine oilers perform frontline deck and engine-room duties aboard ships. Sailors stand lookout watches, handle mooring, maintain decks, and assist with cargo, while oilers lubricate engine-room equipment, record readings, and perform routine maintenance.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Automated monitoring can report RPM, but sailors and marine oilers still rush in when a line suddenly snaps or an unusual engine-room noise appears.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 自动监测能报转速，但缆绳突然崩了、机舱异响，还得水手和加油工冲上去。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年水手与船舶机油员在岗约 3.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.28 万人，净增约 0.07 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.39 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.96 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代水手与船舶加油工，也难压缩这门活。导航辅助和设备监测被船舶自动化接手，但甲板作业、机舱维护和应急高度依赖人，海上突发更要人。会多岗、持证、能应急的人更稳，纯单一监测会被系统稀释。
ai_s3_list: 甲板作业：系泊瞭望靠人。
机舱维护：加油紧螺栓靠人。
应急处突：风浪故障要人。
异常判断：异响靠经验。
综合协调：把甲板机舱串起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——导航与监测被系统分流，但甲板机舱和应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着稳：被替代的是「单一监测」，不是「岗位」。会多岗、持证、能应急的人，反而随自动化更稀缺。怕的是只盯表、不学多岗的水手。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 航海/轮机专业打底，在校把船员证考了。AI 时代监测被接走，早点练多岗和应急。
从「单岗」升级成「甲板+机舱多能」，学自动化监测，争取考高级船员。
突出出海经验和证书，写清跑过哪些船型。有船员证优先。
招人别只看力气，看守规和应急。能多岗、持证的水手值得更高航次奖。

ai_s7_trends: 导航与机舱监测继续自动化。
多岗持证船员更吃香。
预测性维护提升安全。

body: 水手与船舶加油工在船舶上分别承担甲板与机舱的一线勤务：水手负责值班瞭望、系泊、甲板保养与货物协助，加油工负责机舱设备的润滑、抄表和日常维护。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 自动监测能报转速，但缆绳突然崩了、机舱异响，还得水手和加油工冲上去。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate repair plans and estimates, but craftspeople still use their hands to judge leather grain when replacing soles and thread tension when stitching.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 9,500 shoe and leather workers and repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 9,100 by 2034, a net loss of about 400 jobs, with approximately 900 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $36,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace shoe and leather repairers, but it will change assessment and business operations. Experienced craftspeople once relied entirely on judgment to decide how to repair an item and what to charge; scanning assessments, color-matching recommendations, and order-management software now assist them. Hands-on skills such as resoling, stitching, and dyeing cannot be performed well by machines because every damaged pair is different and requires human judgment and craftsmanship.
ai_s2_accel: AI color matching and leather recognition: scan surfaces to recommend restoration and color plans
CNC sole processing: precisely grind replacement components from data
Remote orders and logistics: mail-in repairs extend stores to more customers
Automated equipment assistance: automatic gluing and grinding reduce physical effort
ai_s2_auto: Order and customer management: scan items into inventory, track progress, and send automated notifications
Repair-plan and estimate recommendations: systems suggest plans based on damage type
Leather and component inventory management: automated counts and purchasing reminders
Online orders and appointments: mini-programs/platforms schedule work automatically
ai_s3_list: Damage assessment and repair plans: separated glue joints, broken soles, and cracked leather each require an experienced decision.
Craft feel in resoling and stitching: stitch tension, glue quantity, and leather grain all depend on skilled hands.
Color matching and restoration judgment: how to correct color differences and how many coats to apply depend on a craftsperson's aesthetic eye.
Trust-based customer communication: clearly explain price, timeline, and expected results to retain repeat customers.
Understanding materials and tools: one wrong choice among leather, adhesive, thread, or dye can ruin the job.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects that about half the work is desk-based. Software is taking over orders, plans, and inventory, but AI offers limited help with hands-on resoling, stitching, and dyeing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Stronger AI increases the need for craftspeople who understand leather, manage a business, and implement plans. It can calculate a repair plan but cannot stitch the sole. Low-end repairers who only replace soles mechanically and lack aesthetic or business skills face pressure, while specialists in premium care become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A university degree is unnecessary. Vocational programs in apparel, leather-goods design, or footwear design combined with apprenticeship are a strong route. Develop fine hand skills, then add photography and online-business knowledge. In the AI era, premium leather-goods care specialists are scarce and valued.

Advance your craft toward premium care: luxury leather maintenance, custom dyeing, renovation, and restoration. Learn online order intake, customer management, and pricing to move from shoe repairer to leather-care specialist.

Begin as an apprentice in a shoe repair shop, first learning sole replacement and basic care before advancing to dyeing and restoration. Quantified resume results such as daily repair volume and repeat-customer count are more useful than general claims about craftsmanship.

Do not hire only for basic repair ability; assess breadth of technique and service awareness. Craftspeople who repair premium leather goods, maintain customer relationships, and study new methods are hard to find and worth retaining at high pay.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Scan items into inventory, track progress, maintain customer records
Identify leather types and recommend care plans
Appointment scheduling, mail-in repair orders, review management
Precise grinding and reduced physical effort
Mail-in repair tracking and nationwide customer reach
Cleaning and care plans for different leathers
Customer records, follow-up reminders, promotional notifications

ai_s7_trends: Mass-market shoe repair has thin margins, while premium leather care and custom dyeing become major profit sources, shifting craftspeople toward care-specialist roles.

Online mail-in repairs combined with neighborhood stores allow small shops to survive through private customer channels and repeat business, while stores that only wait for walk-ins continue to shrink.
Hand craftsmanship is regaining value. Specialists with premium-care, aesthetic, and business skills are scarce, and an aging workforce creates opportunities for young entrants.

body: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers make, repair, and care for footwear and leather goods through manual processes including resoling, stitching, patching leather, coloring, and polishing. They are a traditional trade connecting manufacturing with community services.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate repair plans and estimates, but craftspeople still use their hands to judge leather grain when replacing soles and thread tension when stitching.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出修理方案和报价，但换底时皮料的纹理走向、上线时的松紧手感，还得靠师傅的手去拿捏。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人修理在岗约 0.95 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.91 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.09 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.60 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代鞋匠和皮革修理工，但会改变「评估和经营」这件事。以前全凭老师傅的经验判断怎么修、报多少价，现在有扫码评估、配色推荐、订单管理软件。可换底、缝线、染色这些手上功夫，机器做不了，也做不好——每双鞋的破损都不一样，需要人的判断和手艺。
ai_s2_accel: AI 配色与皮料识别：扫描皮面推荐修复与配色方案
数控鞋底加工：按数据精确打磨换底配件
远程下单与物流：寄修服务让门店触达更远客户
设备自动化辅助：自动上胶、打磨设备减轻体力活
ai_s2_auto: 订单与顾客管理：扫码入库、进度追踪、自动通知
维修方案与报价建议：系统根据破损类型推荐方案
皮料配件库存管理：自动盘点与采购提醒
线上接单与预约：小程序/平台自动排期
ai_s3_list: 破损判断与修复方案：开胶、断底、裂皮各有修法，靠经验拍板。
换底上线的工艺手感：针脚松紧、胶水用量、皮料纹理，都是手上功夫。
配色与美容判断：色差怎么调、上几遍色，师傅的审美就是溢价。
与顾客的信任沟通：报价、工期、效果预期，说清楚才能留住回头客。
对材料与工具的理解：皮料、胶水、缝线、染料，选错一步全盘皆输。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在桌面完成——订单、方案、库存这些正被软件接管，但换底、缝线、染色这些现场手艺，AI 帮不上太多忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，越需要懂皮料、会经营、能落地的师傅去执行——它会帮你算方案，但不会替你把鞋底缝好。真正被挤压的是「只会机械换底、没有审美和经营能力」的低端修理，会做高端养护的师傅反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不需要大学文凭，职校的服装与皮具设计、鞋类设计专业加学徒实践是好路线。重点练手上的精细功夫，再补一点拍照和线上运营。AI 时代，会养护高端皮具的师傅稀缺又吃香。
把手艺往「高端养护」做：奢侈品皮具护理、定制染色、翻新修复。同时把线上接单、客户管理和定价学起来，从「修鞋匠」升级为「皮具护理师」。
从修鞋铺学徒做起，先学换底和基础护理，再往染色、翻新走。简历上写「每日修鞋量」「复购客户数」这类可量化成果，比空说手艺好有用。
招人别只看「会不会修」，要看工艺广度和服务意识。能修高端皮具、会维护客户关系、肯钻研新工艺的师傅，值得高薪留，这类人很难找。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 扫码入库、进度追踪、客户档案
识别皮料类型、推荐护理方案
预约排期、寄修下单、评价管理
不同皮料的清洁养护方案
客户档案、回访提醒、优惠推送

ai_s7_trends: 大众修鞋走薄利，高端皮具养护与定制染色成为主要利润来源，师傅向「护理师」升级。
线上寄修 + 社区门店结合，小修鞋铺靠私域和复购活下来，纯等客上门的门店继续收缩。
手工手艺价值回归，会高端养护、有审美和经营能力的师傅稀缺，年龄断层反而给年轻人留出机会。

body: 鞋匠与皮革修理工负责鞋靴与皮具的制作、维修与养护，包括换底、上线、补皮、上色、抛光等手工工序，是连接「制造业」与「社区服务」的传统手艺工种。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出修理方案和报价，但换底时皮料的纹理走向、上线时的松紧手感，还得靠师傅的手去拿捏。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help prepare a lesson plan, but when a student acts out in class, you still have to stand at the front and restore order.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 510,100 short-term teachers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 518,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 8,400 jobs, with about 61,100 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $38,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace substitute teachers, but it will take over lesson preparation. Lesson-planning and grading tools automate routine preparation, shifting teachers' time from creating materials toward classroom management, real-time adaptation, and student support. People who merely read prepared scripts will face pressure, while those who manage classrooms and adapt effectively will remain secure.
ai_s3_list: Classroom management: People maintain discipline.
Real-time adaptation: People respond to unexpected events.
Student support: People respond to emotions.
Taking over instructional progress: People verify continuity.
Accountability: People remain responsible in the classroom.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the middle range of AI exposure. Preparation is automated, but classroom management and adaptability still depend mainly on people. The occupation remains stable despite high turnover.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean the occupation is risk-free. AI accelerates preparation, not the role itself. People who manage classrooms and adapt will remain secure, while tools will displace those who only read prepared scripts.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through teacher education and practice classroom management and adaptability while in school. Script-reading roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop real-time teaching skills early.
Advance from reading scripts to classroom management and adaptability. Build experience across multiple grade levels and work toward a permanent teaching role or public-school recruitment.
Highlight substitute-teaching and discipline-management experience, specifying the grades taught. A teaching credential is preferred.
Do not hire based only on academic credentials. Assess classroom management and adaptability. People who can stabilize a class deserve opportunities.

ai_s7_trends: Lesson preparation tools are spreading.
Classroom management and adaptability become core skills.
People who can transition into permanent roles are more secure.

body: Short-term substitute teachers provide temporary instruction when schools are understaffed, taking over classes, maintaining discipline and instructional progress, completing basic grading, and documenting handoffs. They provide flexible staffing that keeps education operating.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help prepare a lesson plan, but when a student acts out in class, you still have to stand at the front and restore order.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你出教案，但那学生当场闹起来，还得你站上台稳住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教师、简餐在岗约 51.01 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 51.85 万人，净增约 0.84 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.85 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代代课教师，但会接手备课准备。教案与批改工具把常规准备自动化，教师的时间从「做材料」挪向「进班控场、临场应变与学生安抚」。真正被挤掉的是只念现成稿的人，能控场能应变的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 进班控场：纪律靠人稳。
临场应变：突发靠人对。
学生安抚：情绪靠人接。
进度接管：衔接靠人查。
责任归属：课堂现场担责。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——备课被自动化，但控场与应变仍主要靠人，岗位整体稳但流动性大。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于无风险：被加速的是「备课」，不是「岗位」。会控场、能应变的人更稳，只念现成稿的人会被工具接走。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 师范打底，在校多练控场与应变。AI 时代纯念稿在缩，早点练临场。
从「念稿」升级成「控场 + 应变」，积累多年级经验，争取转长期或考编。
突出顶课与纪律经历，写清带过哪些年级。有资格证优先。
招人别只看学历，要看控场和应变。能稳住班的人值得给机会。

ai_s7_trends: 备课工具化普及。
控场与应变成核心能力。
能转长期的人更稳。

body: 代课教师（短期）在学校临时缺人时代替授课，接管班级、维持纪律与教学进度，完成基础批改与交接，是教育运行的弹性补位角色。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你出教案，但那学生当场闹起来，还得你站上台稳住。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can assist with surgery, but machines cannot replace the speed of passing instruments, error-free counts, and the unspoken coordination that lets a technologist respond to a surgeon's glance.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 115,600 technologists were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 120,800 by 2034, a net gain of about 5,200 jobs, with about 7,000 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $62,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and surgical robots will not replace surgical technologists soon, but they will change operating-room responsibilities. As robotic surgery spreads, technologists must learn new equipment and workflows. RFID and intelligent systems increasingly assist with instrument counts and supply management. The core work that remains is immediate intraoperative coordination, sterile technique, and real-time response, which depend on training and teamwork that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: Expanding use of surgical robots such as da Vinci
Growing adoption of smart instruments and disposable supplies
ai_s2_auto: Electronic assistance for instrument counts with RFID
Intelligent surgical supply management and recording
Automatically generated operating schedules and setup lists
Automated tracking of instrument sterilization workflows
ai_s3_list: Immediate intraoperative teamwork: The instrument arrives as soon as the surgeon extends a hand.
Rigorous counting and verification: Every sponge, needle, and instrument is accounted for.
Sterile discipline: Sterile awareness becomes an automatic reflex.
Response to emergencies: The team cannot lose composure during major bleeding or equipment failure.
Specialty procedure experience: Technologists understand the requirements of orthopedic, neurosurgical, and other procedures.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means workflow management is becoming digital. AI and other systems assist with counting, recordkeeping, and scheduling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI assists with processes outside the sterile field, while instrument passing, sterile control, and real-time response in surgery still depend on people. Surgical robots extend the surgeon's hands; technologists create effective team coordination. Those who understand new equipment and workflows will remain more secure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study surgical technology, nursing, or a related medical field, and complete the required hospital internship. Develop psychological resilience, steady hands, and attention to detail. People who fear blood or high-pressure environments should choose carefully.

Learn to support robotic procedures and intelligent instrument systems, and actively build specialty procedure experience. Advance from a general assistant to a key specialty technologist and earn higher-level credentials.

A nursing or medical background provides the smoothest transition through residency-style training or continuing education. On your resume, specify the number of procedures supported, specialties covered, and robotic surgery experience.
Do not hire technologists based only on credentials. Assess operating-room experience and emergency response. Young professionals willing to learn robotic surgery deserve focused development.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated counts of instruments and sponges

ai_s7_trends: As robotic surgery volume continues to expand, technologists are shifting from manual assistance toward robotic-case support and intelligent workflow management. Professionals who understand new equipment are in greater demand.
Growing surgical volume and wider use of minimally invasive surgery are driving stable demand for technologists, supported by expanding healthcare resources.
Instrument counting and supply management are becoming fully digital, shifting technologists toward combined roles as specialty technical experts and quality-control professionals.

body: Surgical technologists prepare operating rooms, pass and count instruments during procedures, maintain sterile environments, and organize instruments afterward. They help surgical teams deliver safe and efficient procedures and hold key technical roles in the operating room.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robots can assist with surgery, but machines cannot replace the speed of passing instruments, error-free counts, and the unspoken coordination that lets a technologist respond to a surgeon's glance.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能辅助做手术，但递器械的手速、清点的零差错、医生一个眼神你就能接上——手术室里这些「默契」，机器替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年技术专家在岗约 11.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 12.08 万人，净增约 0.52 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.70 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.28 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和手术机器人不会立刻取代手术技术员，但会改变手术室的分工。机器人辅助手术普及后，技术员要学新设备、新流程；器械清点和耗材管理正在被 RFID 和智能系统辅助。留下的核心是术中即时配合、无菌把控和临场应变——这些靠训练和默契的活，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 手术机器人（如达芬奇）台次扩张
智能器械与一次性耗材普及
术中影像与导航系统辅助
手术室数字化管理平台覆盖
ai_s2_auto: 器械清点 RFID 电子化辅助
手术耗材智能管理与记录
手术排程与备台单自动生成
器械消毒流程自动化追踪
ai_s3_list: 术中即时配合的默契：医生伸手，器械就到。
清点核验的严谨：纱布、针、器械，一件不差。
无菌操作的纪律：无菌意识刻进条件反射。
突发状况的应变：大出血、器械故障，台上不能乱。
专科手术的积累：骨科、神外，不同台型心里有数。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的流程管理环节正在被数字化——清点、记录、排程，AI 和系统都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「台下的流程」，台上递器械、无菌把控、临场应变依然靠人。手术机器人做的是「医生的手」，技术员的价值在「团队的默契」。会新设备、懂新流程的技术员更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选手术技术、护理或医学相关专业，医院实习是必须的。心理素质和手稳心细都要练，怕血怕高压的慎重。
把机器人手术跟台、智能器械系统学起来，主动接专科手术。从「通用助手」升级为「专科技术骨干」，考取更高级别证书。
有护理或医学背景最顺，可走规培或进修路径。简历上多写「跟过多少台手术、会哪些专科配合、有没有机器人手术经验」。
招技术员别只看证书，要看跟台经验和应变能力。愿意学机器人手术的年轻人，值得重点培养。

ai_s7_trends: 手术机器人台次持续扩张，技术员从「手动配合」转向「机器人台跟台+智能流程管理」，会新设备的技术员更抢手。
手术量增长与微创手术普及推动技术员需求稳定增长，岗位受医疗资源扩张带动。
器械清点与耗材管理全面数字化，技术员向「专科技术骨干+质控」复合角色转变。

body: 手术技术员在手术室内负责术前备台、术中器械传递与清点、无菌环境维护及术后整理，协助外科团队保障手术安全顺畅，是手术室团队中的关键技术岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机器人能辅助做手术，但递器械的手速、清点的零差错、医生一个眼神你就能接上——手术室里这些「默契」，机器替代不了。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can identify suspicious people in vast amounts of surveillance footage, but a police officer still has to personally say, 'Sir, please show me your identification' on the platform.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 3,100 transit and railroad police were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 3,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 100 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 200 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $82,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace transit and railroad police, but it will change crime prevention and control. Work once depended on people watching monitors and patrolling platforms; now facial recognition, crowd-flow analysis, and AI abnormal-behavior detection provide assistance and early warnings about suspects and crowd risks. Yet core duties such as patrols, dispute resolution, and emergency response still require people. AI flags a suspicious person, but officers decide how to question them and control the scene.
ai_s2_accel: AI public-opinion and risk assessment: use passenger-flow data to predict public-safety risk areas
Smart fare-gate integration: automatically stop fare evasion and abnormal passage
Emergency command platform: one-touch dispatch and multiagency coordination
Mobile law-enforcement terminals: digitize on-site incident records
ai_s2_auto: Facial recognition and watchlists: automatically compare and alert on suspicious individuals
Intelligent video surveillance: automatically detect unusual behavior and unattended objects
Crowd-flow analysis: assess and warn about platform density in real time
Patrol scheduling system: automatically schedule tasks, locations, and personnel
ai_s3_list: On-site dispute resolution: experience steadies passenger conflicts and lost-person requests.
Judgment in emergencies: track intrusions, suspicious objects, and gate-crashing demand calm decisions about what comes first.
Tact in public interactions: conduct checks without escalating tension and provide service without gaps, a skill built over time.
Patrol observation: instantly noticing who appears out of place in a crowd is expert work.
Coordination among parties: people must lead collaboration across station operations, security screening, transit operations, and medical services.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 reflects that most work happens on site and on platforms. AI greatly assists desk-based monitoring and crowd analysis, but it can only help observe; officers still perform the core work of patrolling, responding to incidents, and managing emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure still brings change. AI makes prevention more precise, directing police resources where they matter through facial-recognition watchlists and crowd warnings. Passive duty based on pure patrols without data faces pressure, while officers who use intelligent platforms and respond rapidly to emergencies receive greater responsibility.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study at a police academy or in public security, political science, or law, then enter transit or railroad police through civil-service recruitment. Prepare early for physical fitness tests and background screening. Officers who understand data and intelligent policing are more competitive in the AI era, and this is a stable career with a strong sense of honor.

Learn video analysis and intelligent policing platforms instead of remaining limited to patrols. Strengthen emergency response and dispute mediation, advancing from patrol officer to a versatile frontline emergency-response specialist.

Public security recruitment examinations have a high barrier. An alternative is to begin in security screening or security management at a rail-transit company and build on-site experience. Quantify achievements on your resume, such as incidents handled, patrol distance, and safety record.

Do not hire solely for physical fitness; assess response capability and learning ability. Officers who skillfully use intelligent platforms, mediate disputes, and endure peak-period patrols are valuable frontline personnel who deserve priority in training and promotion.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically detect unusual behavior and unattended objects
Compare suspicious individuals and push alerts
Stop fare evasion and abnormal passage
Incident registration and auditable response records

ai_s7_trends: Urban rail systems continue to expand, and new lines create new public-safety needs, increasing transit police staffing and positions.
Facial-recognition watchlists, crowd-flow analysis, and intelligent surveillance are becoming standard, shifting policing from labor-intensive patrols toward precise, data-driven prevention.
Police roles are advancing from patrol duty to a combination of data analysis and rapid emergency response, raising overall capability requirements.

body: Transit and railroad police patrol urban rail systems, railroad stations and lines, and bus hubs; protect passenger-flow safety; resolve disputes; and respond to emergencies, maintaining order and passenger safety across public transportation systems.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can identify suspicious people in vast amounts of surveillance footage, but a police officer still has to personally say, 'Sir, please show me your identification' on the platform.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从海量监控里揪出可疑人员，但站台上那句「先生请出示证件」，还得警察亲自开口。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年公交与铁路警察在岗约 0.31 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.32 万人，净增约 0.01 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.02 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.23 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代公交与铁路警察，但会改变「防控」的方式。以前靠人工盯监控和站台巡逻，现在有人脸识别、大客流分析、AI 异常行为检测辅助，可疑人员和客流风险能提前预警。可现场巡逻、纠纷处置、突发应对这些核心，还得靠人——AI 告诉你谁可疑，但怎么盘查、怎么控制现场，是警察的活。
ai_s2_accel: AI 舆情与风险研判：客流数据预测治安风险点
智能闸机联动：逃票、异常通行自动拦截
应急指挥平台：突发警情一键调度联动
移动执法终端：现场处置记录数字化
ai_s2_auto: 人脸识别与重点人员布控：可疑人员自动比对预警
智能视频监控：异常行为、遗留物自动检测
大客流分析：站台客流密度实时评估预警
巡逻排班系统：任务、点位、人员自动排程
ai_s3_list: 现场纠纷处置：乘客冲突、走失求助，怎么稳场子，靠经验。
突发事件的临场判断：跳轨、可疑物、冲卡，先做什么后做什么要冷静。
与群众打交道的分寸：盘查不激化、服务不缺位，是长期修炼。
巡逻中的观察力：人流里谁不对劲，一眼能看出，是行家功夫。
与各方的协同：站务、安检、运营、医护怎么配合，靠人牵头。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在现场、在站台上——监控、客流这些桌面活正被 AI 大幅辅助，但巡逻、处警、突发应对这些核心，AI 只能帮忙看，不能替人做。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于没变化。AI 让防控更精准：人脸布控、大客流预警让警力用到刀刃上。真正被挤压的是「纯巡逻、不碰数据」的被动值守方式，会用智能平台、能快速处突的警察反而更受重用。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读警校或政法类专业，走公务员招录进轨道公安或铁路公安。身体素质、体能和政审要提前准备。AI 时代，会看数据、懂智能警务的警察更吃香，这是一条稳定且有荣誉感的职业路。
把视频研判、智能警务平台用起来，别停留在「纯巡逻」。同时强化应急处突和纠纷调解能力，从「巡逻警」升级为「综合处突骨干」。
公安系统走招录考试，门槛高；可先从轨道交通企业的安检、安保管理岗切入，积累现场经验。简历上写「处置警情数、巡逻里程、安全记录」这类可量化成果。
招人别只看体能，要看处置能力和学习能力。能熟练用智能平台、会调解纠纷、扛得住高峰巡逻的警察，是宝贵的基层力量，值得在培训和晋升上倾斜。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 异常行为、遗留物自动检测
可疑人员比对、预警推送

ai_s7_trends: 城市轨道交通持续扩张，新线路带来新治安需求，轨道公安编制与岗位在增加。
人脸布控、大客流分析和智能监控成为标配，警务模式从「人海巡逻」转向「数据精准防控」。
警察角色从「巡逻值守」升级为「数据研判 + 快速处突」复合型，综合能力要求提高。
